content:
Divisibility by 9: \(1+7+3+a=11+a\) must be divisible by 9. Thus \(a=7\).

Divisibility by 11: \((1+3)-(7+b)=-3-b\) must be divisible by 11. Thus \(b=8\).

Divisibility by 6: \(173c\) must be even and have digit sum divisible by 3. Even digits give \(c\in\{0,2,4,6,8\}\). \(11+c\) divisible by 3 only when \(c=4\).

Sum: \(7+8+4=19\).

\boxed{19}
